fr.statement: The system shall let an administrator create a brand (name, description, operating hubs) and create its menu items (name, category, positive VND price, brand and availability).
The system shall let any visitor view brands and menu items filtered by hub and by category.
The system shall let an administrator edit brand details and a menu item’s name, category, price and brand.
The system shall soft-delete brands and menu items, so that historical orders and reports keep their names and prices.
The system shall let an administrator set item availability; unavailable or inactive items shall not be orderable.
The system shall reject any order line whose item belongs to a brand the chosen hub does not operate.
The system shall let an administrator create a hub with a district, an address and a whole-number kitchen capacity greater than zero.
The system shall display hub load as 100 times the count of Confirmed or Preparing orders divided by positive integer kitchen capacity; the new order is not counted.
The system shall let an administrator edit a hub’s district, address and positive integer capacity, and recompute displayed load after a capacity change.
The system shall soft-delete a hub, removing it from ordering while preserving its historical orders and report rows.
The system shall refuse a new order when the chosen hub’s load is 90 % or above and shall ask the customer to choose another hub.
The system shall let an administrator create a voucher with a code, a type (PERCENT or FIXED), a value, a maximum discount, a minimum subtotal, validity dates and an active flag.
The system shall let an administrator view, edit and deactivate vouchers.
The system shall accept at most one active voucher within its validity dates and check its minimum-subtotal condition against S before discounts.
The system shall let a customer build an order from the menus of one hub, with 1 to 30 lines and a quantity of 1 to 20 per line.
The system shall reject an order whose item subtotal is below 50,000.
The system shall reject an order whose delivery distance exceeds 8.0 km.
The system shall charge D = 15,000 for d ≤ 2 km; 15,000 + 5,000 × ceil(d − 2) for 2 < d ≤ 5; and 30,000 + 7,000 × ceil(d − 5) for 5 < d ≤ 8.
The system shall charge R = 20% of non-waived D when placement time in Vietnam (UTC+7) is in [11:00, 13:00) or [17:30, 19:30); otherwise R = 0.
The system shall add a flat 10,000 rain surcharge while the administrator’s heavy-rain flag is on, using the flag value snapshotted on the order.
The system shall waive the delivery fee and the rush surcharge when the item subtotal is 300,000 or more, while the rain surcharge still applies.
The system shall apply a Quiet Kitchen discount of 10 % of the item subtotal when the hub load at placement is below 30 %.
The system shall calculate PERCENT voucher V on S − Q, limited by the voucher cap and S − Q; FIXED V shall not exceed S − Q.

The system shall calculate S, Q, V, F = S − Q − V, D, R, R2 and raw total = F + D + R + R2 in BR10 order, retain fractional values without intermediate rounding or truncation, then round once to the nearest 1,000 VND, half up.
The system shall show an itemised price breakdown — subtotal, Quiet Kitchen discount, voucher, food total, delivery fee, rush surcharge, rain surcharge, rounded total — before payment.
The system shall allow items to be edited only while the order is Placed, and any recalculation shall reuse the stored placement snapshot.

The system shall allow Customer cancellation in Placed or Confirmed, Kitchen Staff rejection in Placed with a reason, and Admin cancellation in Confirmed; online-paid cancellations shall be refunded in full (simulated).
The system shall store a price snapshot of timestamp, hub load and rain flag at placement so that the price stays reproducible.
The system shall register a Local Customer with a Vietnamese mobile number of exactly ten digits starting 03, 05, 07, 08 or 09, and a simulated OTP.
The system shall register a Foreign Tourist with a passport number of 6 to 9 letters or digits, a nationality, a valid email and a simulated email code.
The system shall enforce a unique identifier and a password of at least eight characters stored as a hash.
The system shall store both customer types in one schema using a discriminator, and let an administrator view, edit and deactivate accounts.
The system shall let an administrator assign an available shipper to a Ready order and record the shipper and assignment time (assumption A1).

The system shall enforce all eight transitions and actor/condition constraints in Specification section 2C in the business layer and reject every other transition; Delivered, Cancelled and Failed are terminal.
The system shall require a shipper to confirm cash collected before a COD order may become Delivered.
The system shall let the assigned shipper move Out for Delivery to terminal Failed when the customer is unreachable, recording a reason; financial settlement follows assumption A2.
The system shall offer only the payment methods that belong to the customer’s actor group: MoMo, VNPay and cash for Local Customers; Apple Pay, PayPal and cash for Foreign Tourists.
The system shall refuse Cash on Delivery when the rounded total exceeds 1,000,000.
The system shall record each payment attempt with order, selected method, timestamp and success/failure outcome; only an actor-permitted Strategy may be selected.

The system shall integrate the live VNPay sandbox API for eligible Local Customer orders, authenticate callbacks and validate the order and amount before recording success, and process repeated callbacks idempotently.
The system shall produce a Revenue report for a chosen date range showing total revenue by brand category and by payment method, excluding Cancelled and Failed orders.

The system shall produce a Hub Utilization report showing, per hub, orders handled, average preparation time from Confirmed to Ready, current load percentage and the number of Quiet Kitchen discounts granted.
The system shall let any user switch the interface between English and Vietnamese, and the choice shall persist for the session.
The system shall restrict each role to its own functions on the server, not only in the interface.

The system shall provide an interactive administrator dashboard for R1 and R2 with revenue date-range and hub-selection controls that refresh the respective charts and tables from the same authorised report data.
The system shall let an administrator toggle the heavy-rain flag that the rain surcharge depends on.

The system shall append an audit record for each status change (actor, timestamp, old/new state) and payment attempt (actor, timestamp, method, outcome), without an application-level edit/delete operation.

nfr.target: Price calculation for a valid order of 30 lines completes in under 1.5 seconds server-side.
nfr.verification: Time the engine with 30 valid lines on the documented test machine; record environment, elapsed times and pass/fail in Part 3.

nfr.target: Use MVC separation. Adding a payment method requires one new Strategy class and one registration, with zero edits to existing payment classes.
nfr.verification: Add a sample method in a disposable branch; inspect the diff and rerun existing payment tests. This criterion applies to a payment-extension change request.

nfr.target: All required screens support English/Vietnamese and operate without horizontal page scrolling at 390, 768 and 1440 px; culture switching preserves the cart and session.
nfr.verification: Check each screen and language at the three widths, verify resource keys and repeat switching with a non-empty cart.

nfr.target: Passwords are hashed, never stored as plaintext; every role is refused every server action outside its authorised role and resource scope.
nfr.verification: Inspect stored password representation; run an access matrix for both customer types, Kitchen Staff, Shipper and Admin, including other users’ orders and hubs.

nfr.target: 100% of accepted status changes and payment attempts append a record with actor and timestamp; status changes include old/new state, payment attempts include method/outcome. No application update/delete endpoint is provided.
nfr.verification: Reconcile accepted transitions and payment attempts against audit rows and verify ordinary roles cannot change recorded history.

nfr.target: Zero forbidden transitions are accepted; repeated pricing with identical lines and the stored placement snapshot returns identical components and rounded total.
nfr.verification: Enumerate the state/actor matrix, include at least five forbidden transitions, and repeat boundary pricing inputs against a fixed snapshot.

ambiguities.gap: Section 2C leaves the assignment mechanism open.
ambiguities.assumption: An Admin manually selects an available shipper for a Ready order. The system stores assignment time and shipper. Automatic dispatch is outside the initial scope.
ambiguities.impact: FR-F1; UC F; assignment screen and service.
ambiguities.answer: Not asked; working assumption pending instructor review.

ambiguities.gap: Section 2C leaves the financial result of Failed delivery open.
ambiguities.assumption: Refund online-paid orders in full in the simulated ledger; collect no COD cash. Preserve Failed as its own terminal state and exclude it from R1 revenue.
ambiguities.impact: FR-F4; UC F/D; payment/refund policy and R1.
ambiguities.answer: Not asked; working assumption pending instructor review.

ambiguities.gap: Hotel and room are allowed, but a field structure is not prescribed.
ambiguities.assumption: Store street/address text plus optional hotel name and room. Require a usable delivery address for either customer type; tourists are not required to supply a Vietnamese phone.
ambiguities.impact: FR-E2 and FR-D1; address validation and checkout.
ambiguities.answer: Not asked; working assumption pending instructor review.

ambiguities.gap: BR9 specifies eligibility but not whether a refused voucher should block the whole order.
ambiguities.assumption: Show the refusal and the corrected breakdown with V=0; require the customer to review and confirm that total before placing the order. Never silently submit a higher total.
ambiguities.answer: Not asked; working assumption pending instructor review.

ambiguities.topic: Catalogue price change before a Placed edit
ambiguities.gap: BR17 fixes timestamp/load/rain but does not explicitly say which item prices apply when the catalogue changes before an edit.
ambiguities.assumption: Existing lines retain their recorded unit prices; newly added items use the current catalogue price after availability/membership validation. Recalculation still uses the original timestamp, load and rain snapshot.
ambiguities.impact: FR-D12/D14 and FR-A4; order-line price storage and edit tests.
ambiguities.answer: Not asked; working assumption pending instructor review.
